criteria.await_drain: Sends pause for drain or buffer room under a caller deadline rather than signalling saturation.
criteria.drain_event: Drain appears as a server-session event that restarts queued sends, while the client keeps fail-fast since no drain hook exists there.
criteria.fail_fast: Saturation surfaces at once as a domain error once native answers -1 or the client buffer crosses its cap.

backpressure.instructions: Which backpressure shape should sends use?

criteria.callback: Handlers registered at connect and accept time run checked per event with grouped state passed along.
criteria.reader: A stream::reader over ws::event vends inbound flow from connect and accept with stream close and cancel reuse, leaving sends on the session.
criteria.receive: A single opaque session answers ws::receive with one ws::event variant per pull and also carries send and close.

surface.instructions: What surface should expose session events?

criteria.explicit_insecure: An explicit insecure option, secure unless named, keeps loopback and self-signed testing reachable.
criteria.no_wss: Only ws:// URLs connect and wss:// is refused, pushing TLS termination out of Can.
criteria.verify_only: Every wss handshake verifies through OS trust without exception, confining self-signed peers to the failure path.

tls_client.instructions: Which TLS posture should the wss client take?

criteria.accept_op: Handlers upgrade by calling ws::accept with their request while the adapter resolves the stored native request and server, after which dispatch sends no HTTP reply.
criteria.marked_route: Dispatch upgrades ahead of the handler on marked routes and hands the handler a session in place of a request.
criteria.separate_serve: WebSocket serving runs in an independent ws::serve with its own Bun.serve, apart from HTTP routing.
